gaps.label: What is in the breakfast bowl
gaps.reason: The venue publishes two different descriptions of the same $12 bowl — one says eggs, bacon, cheese and sausage; the other adds garlic butter and gouda. Rather than pick the flattering one, the dish is listed at its confirmed price and the contents are left to the venue to settle.
